studies.title: The coelacanth
studies.caption: Fleshy lobed fins distinguish the coelacanth from most familiar fish. Living specimens connected a fossil lineage with the catches of western Indian Ocean fishermen.
studies.prompt: Underwater lateral natural-history study of Latimeria chalumnae, dark blue fish with pale irregular flecks, paired fleshy lobed pectoral and pelvic fins, two dorsal fins, distinctive three-lobed caudal fin with small central projection. Swimming beside shaded submarine rock ledge, no land legs, no generic tuna tail, no scuba diver or cartoon bubbles.
